notes: Refined normalization scope to align with ClinicalTrials.gov status values and existing RECRUITING filter behavior. No new stories added; improved clarity and dependency precision.

change_log.value: Expanded to explicitly map ClinicalTrials.gov statuses (e.g., RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED) into normalized categories and account for API-level RECRUITING filter behavior.
change_log.note: Ensure alignment with real API semantics

change_log.value: Clarified that enrollment status must be included per trial object within the aggregated response payload returned by EvaluateCare facade.
Specified compatibility with tool_router response schema and chat message rendering expectations.

stories.title: Enrollment Status Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define canonical schema for clinical trial enrollment status including normalized values (RECRUITING, ACTIVE, COMPLETED, UNKNOWN), raw source field mapping from ClinicalTrials.gov, and validation contract for downstream consumers.

stories.title: Enrollment Status Extraction and Normalization Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to extract enrollment status from ClinicalTrials.gov API response and normalize into defined categories (RECRUITING, ACTIVE, COMPLETED). Explicitly map source values such as RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, and handle API-level RECRUITING filters. Missing or ambiguous statuses must default to UNKNOWN.

stories.title: Enrollment Status Integration in EvaluateCare Facade
stories.description: Integrate normalized enrollment status into each clinical trial object within the Evaluate Care response payload so that all returned trials include status alongside metadata (title, location, distance, etc.).

stories.title: Enrollment Status API Contract Exposure
stories.description: Ensure enrollment status field is exposed through FastAPI response models and tool responses, maintaining compatibility with tool_router contracts and chat response rendering structure.

stories.title: Enrollment Status Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for status normalization mappings (including edge cases like missing or unexpected values) and integration tests validating correct propagation of enrollment status through Evaluate Care API responses.
